scenes.text: Five animals more dangerous than sharks.
Hippos are fiercely territorial and surprisingly fast.
Saltwater crocodiles ambush from the water's edge.
Snakes kill tens of thousands of people every year.
Dogs spread rabies, the deadliest disease on this list.
